recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見各階段的顆粒球（骨髓細胞、帶狀核、分葉核）與數個紅血球母細胞，另有一個大型、胞質深藍的早期紅血球前驅細胞；形態上僅見輕微異常，環狀鐵粒母細胞需另以鐵染色確認。
features: Mixed marrow population with maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Erythroid precursors including a large basophilic pronormoblast-like cell with deeply blue cytoplasm
Polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts, some with irregular cytoplasmic outlines
No clear megaloblastoid change, nuclear budding, or multinucleation convincingly seen
Blasts not increased; ring sideroblasts not assessable on Wright stain
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of maturing granulocytic cells, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and band forms, together with erythroid precursors ranging from a large basophilic pronormoblast-like cell to polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts. Dysplastic changes are subtle in this field, and blasts are not increased. Ring sideroblasts cannot be identified on a Romanowsky stain; an iron stain and SF3B1 mutation analysis are required to support MDS with ring sideroblasts and single-lineage (erythroid) dysplasia.

ddx.vs: A normal marrow may look identical on Wright stain; the diagnosis of MDS-RS rests on ring sideroblast quantitation and clonal genetics.
Requires dysplasia in ≥10% of cells in at least two lineages (e.g., hypogranular neutrophils, micromegakaryocytes), not evident here.
Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open-chromatin erythroblasts and giant bands/metamyelocytes.
